parsed.explanation: Outing carries documented state-tolerated targeting: a police LGBTIQ register (2016–), officers luring people to fake meetings to register, harvest contacts and extort money (10+ cases in one province, 2024), 2022–23 raids with forced HIV testing and arbitrary charges, and documented ill-treatment, sexual abuse and extortion by officers. No SOGI anti-discrimination law, no effective complaint route, advocacy groups anonymous — so a targeted visitor has no realistic remedy. Society is described as 'entirely negative', with official and religious hostility. Medical settings are unsafe for disclosure (no gender-affirming care, doctors offering 'cure' methods, disrespectful treatment), which matters for a visitor needing care or medication. Offsetting: same-sex conduct legal, no presentation offence, no documented facility ban, birth-sex ward/custody rule or border marker practice — the last unresolved, not cleared. That places it above the severe-tier police-raid profiles but firmly in High Risk.
